briefings.title: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt: The Road to Superintelligence

people.name: Christine Anderson
people.role: Global Head of Corporate Affairs, Blackstone

briefings.tldr: Eric Schmidt and Blackstone executives discuss the massive CapEx buildout in AI, power, and data centers, noting that AI is shifting from infrastructure to real-world usage like Meta’s Muse and Anthropic’s scaling portfolio adoption.
